entries.query: USE facts MATCH (from:Address {address: "5CF6Ruq6u7DoF6TYxyaFzEuviWi7tjvJtz19XgPS2b7XDCFM"})-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) WHERE t.block_date = "2026-07-11" RETURN to.address AS to_address, t.tx_id AS tx_id, t.block_height AS block_height, t.amount_usd AS amount_usd, t.asset_symbol AS asset_symbol LIMIT 10

USE facts MATCH (from:Address)-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) RETURN t.tx_id AS tx_id LIMIT 10

USE facts MATCH (from:Address)-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) WHERE t.block_date = "2026-07-11" AND t.block_timestamp >= 1783738500000 AND t.block_timestamp < 1783738560000 RETURN t.tx_id AS tx_id, t.block_height AS block_height, t.block_timestamp AS block_timestamp, from.address AS from_address, to.address AS to_address, t.amount AS amount, t.asset_symbol AS asset_symbol LIMIT 10

USE facts MATCH (from:Address {address: "0x2459dedb3012d1e929edd17df26620120bdf11bf"})-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address {address: "0x220bbea2c59e2a1b0a71ffba694834e6822c0b52"}) WHERE t.block_date = "2026-07-11" RETURN to.address AS to_address, t.tx_id AS tx_id, t.block_height AS block_height, t.amount AS amount, t.asset_symbol AS asset_symbol LIMIT 10
USE topology MATCH (a:Address) RETURN a.address AS address, a.labels AS labels, a.risk_score AS risk_score, a.risk_level AS risk_level, a.is_exchange AS is_exchange LIMIT 10

USE topology MATCH (src:Address)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address) RETURN src.address AS from_address, dst.address AS to_address, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp LIMIT 10

USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address) WHERE NOT src:Pool RETURN dst.address AS to_address, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY flow.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 50

USE topology MATCH (src:Address)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"}) WHERE NOT dst:Pool RETURN src.address AS from_address, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY flow.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (src:Address)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address) RETURN src.address AS from_address, dst.address AS to_address, CASE WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum IS NULL THEN "unknown" WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum >= 100000 THEN "large" WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum >= 10000 THEN "medium" ELSE "small" END AS amount_bucket, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[r1:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address {address: "5FHneW46xGXgs5mUiveU4sbTyGBzmstUspZC92UhjJM694ty"}) WHERE NOT src:Pool RETURN src.address AS from_address, dst.address AS to_address, 1 AS hops, r1.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, r1.tx_count AS tx_count LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[r1:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]->(mid:Address)-[r2:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]->(dst:Address) WHERE NOT src:Pool AND NOT src:Protocol AND NOT src:System AND NOT src.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND NOT mid:Pool AND NOT mid:Protocol AND NOT mid:System AND NOT mid.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND mid.is_exchange IS NULL RETURN src.address AS from_address, mid.address AS mid_address, dst.address AS to_address, 2 AS hops, type(r1) AS first_edge, type(r2) AS second_edge, coalesce(r1.amount_usd_sum, r1.bought_usd) AS first_amount_usd, coalesce(r2.amount_usd_sum, r2.bought_usd) AS second_amount_usd LIMIT 25
USE topology MATCH (a:Address) RETURN count(a) AS count LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH SHORTEST 1 (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"} WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]) (()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool AND NOT via:Protocol AND NOT via:System AND NOT via.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]){0,4} ()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address) RETURN b.address LIMIT 50

USE topology MATCH p = SHORTEST 1 (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"} WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]) (()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool AND NOT via:Protocol AND NOT via:System AND NOT via.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]){0,4} ()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address {address: "5FHneW46xGXgs5mUiveU4sbTyGBzmstUspZC92UhjJM694ty"}) RETURN p LIMIT 5

USE topology MATCH p = ANY SHORTEST (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"} WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]) (()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool AND NOT via:Protocol AND NOT via:System AND NOT via.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]){0,4} ()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address {address: "5FHneW46xGXgs5mUiveU4sbTyGBzmstUspZC92UhjJM694ty"}) RETURN p LIMIT 5

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[l:LINKED]-(b:Address) RETURN b.address AS linked_address, b.network AS linked_network, l.basis AS basis, l.confidence AS confidence, l.source_event AS source_event, l.declared_owner AS declared_owner LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[l:LINKED]-(owned:Address)-[r:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address) WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND NOT owned:Pool AND NOT owned:Protocol AND NOT owned:System AND NOT owned.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND owned.address <> b.address AND a.address <> b.address RETURN a.address AS subject_address, owned.address AS linked_via_address, b.address AS counterparty_address, type(r) AS edge, coalesce(r.amount_usd_sum, r.bought_usd) AS amount_usd_sum, coalesce(r.tx_count, r.swap_count) AS tx_count LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[l:LINKED]-(b:Address) WHERE a.network <> b.network RETURN a.address AS address, a.network AS network, b.address AS linked_address, b.network AS linked_network, l.basis AS basis, l.confidence AS confidence LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (owner:Address)-[operation:OPERATED_BY]->(operator:Address {address: "0xdd509c9f91f66a18802ef5b3d54c73b62ea1ca08"}) RETURN owner.address AS owner_address, operation.tx_count AS tx_count, operation.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, coalesce(operation.token_standard, "mixed") AS token_standard, operation.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY operation.tx_count DESC LIMIT 10

USE topology MATCH (victim:Address {address: "0x1874a43d7c6d888f9eda3d22a3a49704e3cadb24"})-[paid:FLOWS_TO]->(pool:Pool)-[removal:REMOVED_LIQUIDITY]->(receiver:Address) WHERE NOT victim:Pool AND NOT victim:Protocol AND NOT victim:System AND NOT victim.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND receiver.address <> victim.address RETURN pool.address AS pool_address, receiver.address AS receiver_address, max(paid.amount_usd_sum) AS paid_in_usd, sum(removal.usd) AS removed_usd, max(removal.receiver_added_usd) AS receiver_added_usd, sum(removal.usd) - max(removal.receiver_added_usd) AS receiver_profit_usd, max(removal.receiver_provided) AS receiver_provided ORDER BY removed_usd DESC LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "0x1874a43d7c6d888f9eda3d22a3a49704e3cadb24"})-[r1:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]->(mid:Address)-[r2:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]->(dst:Address) WHERE NOT src:Pool AND NOT src:Protocol AND NOT src:System AND NOT src.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND NOT mid:Pool AND NOT mid:Protocol AND NOT mid:System AND NOT mid.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND mid.is_exchange IS NULL AND dst.address <> src.address RETURN mid.address AS via_address, type(r2) AS exit_edge, dst.address AS to_address, coalesce(r2.amount_usd_sum, r2.bought_usd) AS exit_usd LIMIT 25 UNION MATCH (src:Address {address: "0x1874a43d7c6d888f9eda3d22a3a49704e3cadb24"})-[r1:FLOWS_TO|ADDED_LIQUIDITY]->(mid:Pool)-[r2:REMOVED_LIQUIDITY]->(dst:Address) WHERE NOT src:Pool AND NOT src:Protocol AND NOT src:System AND NOT src.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND dst.address <> src.address RETURN mid.address AS via_address, type(r2) AS exit_edge, dst.address AS to_address, r2.usd AS exit_usd LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (p:Address {address: "0x00aea4ccd2a12f955bfae8b8741cbee14d38e755"}) WHERE p:Pool RETURN p.address AS address, labels(p) AS node_labels, p.labels AS labels LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH (a:Address) WHERE a.address IN ["0x966890d38bfd587c9d6fd6123389dfe18ac9de0e", "0x09e9df72f639875b58dbfd356e31c47b0b87f65b"] RETURN a.address AS address, labels(a) AS node_labels, a.labels AS labels, a.token_standard AS token_standard LIMIT 2

USE topology MATCH (a:Address)-[f:FLOWS_TO]->(b:Address) WHERE f.last_seen_timestamp >= 1791244800000 RETURN a.address AS from_address, b.address AS to_address, f.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, f.tx_count AS tx_count, f.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, f.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp, a.labels AS from_labels, b.labels AS to_labels, a.is_exchange AS from_is_exchange, b.is_exchange AS to_is_exchange ORDER BY f.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (a:Address)-[f:FLOWS_TO]->(b:Address) WHERE f.last_seen_timestamp >= 1791244800000 RETURN a.address AS sender, sum(f.amount_usd_sum) AS sent_usd, count(*) AS links ORDER BY sent_usd DESC LIMIT 10
USE topology MATCH (a:Mixer) RETURN a.address AS address, labels(a) AS node_labels, a.labels AS labels LIMIT 25
USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "0x844e7f539ec3e90391b35843001e8624bef6eb83"}) RETURN a.address AS address, labels(a) AS node_labels, a.labels AS labels LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH (f:Address {address: "0xe78b036bd6da158cd61a3dac3f67e18f62ecddfd"})-[d:DEPLOYED_CONTRACT]->(p:Address {address: "0x844e7f539ec3e90391b35843001e8624bef6eb83"}) RETURN p.address AS address, d.block_height AS block_height, d.tx_id AS tx_id LIMIT 1

USE facts MATCH (r:Address {address: "0xb672a5d825f82dea8574711d1da696fcc48d2ae0"})-[t:TRANSFER]->(b:Address {address: "0x844e7f539ec3e90391b35843001e8624bef6eb83"}) WHERE t.block_date = "2026-10-20" RETURN t.tx_id AS tx_id, t.asset_contract AS asset_contract, t.asset_symbol AS asset_symbol, t.amount_usd AS amount_usd LIMIT 50

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "0x04911a118f11c75667e4d0dfb8e640af5a353550"})-[f:FLOWS_TO]->(b:Address) WHERE NOT a:Pool RETURN a.address AS from_address, b.address AS to_address, f.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, f.tx_count AS tx_count, f.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, f.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp, a.labels AS from_labels, b.labels AS to_labels, a.is_exchange AS from_is_exchange, b.is_exchange AS to_is_exchange ORDER BY f.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (b:Address)-[f:FLOWS_TO]->(a:Address {address: "0x7e3702e9dfaa847f9829a258f1e26fa431160662"}) WHERE NOT a:Pool RETURN b.address AS from_address, a.address AS to_address, f.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, f.tx_count AS tx_count, f.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, f.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp, b.labels AS from_labels, a.labels AS to_labels, b.is_exchange AS from_is_exchange, a.is_exchange AS to_is_exchange ORDER BY f.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "0x04911a118f11c75667e4d0dfb8e640af5a353550"})-[f:FLOWS_TO]->(b:Address) WHERE NOT a:Pool RETURN a.address AS from_address, b.address AS to_address, f.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, f.tx_count AS tx_count, f.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, f.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp, a.labels AS from_labels, b.labels AS to_labels, a.is_exchange AS from_is_exchange, b.is_exchange AS to_is_exchange ORDER BY f.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 25 UNION ALL MATCH (c:Address)-[g:FLOWS_TO]->(d:Address {address: "0x04911a118f11c75667e4d0dfb8e640af5a353550"}) WHERE NOT d:Pool RETURN c.address AS from_address, d.address AS to_address, g.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, g.tx_count AS tx_count, g.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, g.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp, c.labels AS from_labels, d.labels AS to_labels, c.is_exchange AS from_is_exchange, d.is_exchange AS to_is_exchange ORDER BY g.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "0x04911a118f11c75667e4d0dfb8e640af5a353550"}) RETURN a.degree_in AS senders, a.degree_out AS receivers, a.tx_total_count AS tx_count, a.total_volume_usd AS volume_usd, a.first_activity_timestamp AS first_active, a.last_activity_timestamp AS last_active LIMIT 1

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "0x04911a118f11c75667e4d0dfb8e640af5a353550"})-[f:FLOWS_TO]->(b:Address) WHERE NOT a:Pool AND b.is_exchange IS NOT NULL RETURN a.address AS from_address, b.address AS to_address, f.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, f.tx_count AS tx_count, f.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, f.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp, a.labels AS from_labels, b.labels AS to_labels, a.is_exchange AS from_is_exchange, b.is_exchange AS to_is_exchange ORDER BY f.last_seen_timestamp DESC ORDER BY f.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH p = SHORTEST 1 (a:Address {address: "0x31a817802ee183eb8b13167ffe24bd28dcc6f30c"} WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]) (()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool AND NOT via:Protocol AND NOT via:System AND NOT via.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]){0,4} ()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address {address: "0x7e3702e9dfaa847f9829a258f1e26fa431160662"}) RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.address] AS route LIMIT 5

USE topology MATCH p = (a:Address {address: "0x31a817802ee183eb8b13167ffe24bd28dcc6f30c"} WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]) (()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool AND NOT via:Protocol AND NOT via:System AND NOT via.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]){0,2} ()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address {address: "0x7e3702e9dfaa847f9829a258f1e26fa431160662"}) RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.address] AS route, length(p) AS hops LIMIT 5

USE topology MATCH p = (a:Address {address: "0x04911a118f11c75667e4d0dfb8e640af5a353550"} WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]) (()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]->(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool AND NOT via:Protocol AND NOT via:System AND NOT via.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]){0,2} ()-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]->(b:Address) RETURN b.address AS to_address, length(p) AS hops LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH p = (a:Address {address: "0x04911a118f11c75667e4d0dfb8e640af5a353550"} WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]) (()<-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool AND NOT via:Protocol AND NOT via:System AND NOT via.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]){0,2} ()<-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address) RETURN b.address AS from_address, length(p) AS hops LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "0x7e3702e9dfaa847f9829a258f1e26fa431160662"})-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(c:Address)-[:FLOWS_TO|SWAPPED]-(b:Address {address: "0x31a817802ee183eb8b13167ffe24bd28dcc6f30c"}) WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND NOT c:Pool AND NOT c:Protocol AND NOT c:System AND NOT c.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] RETURN DISTINCT c.address AS shared_address LIMIT 25
USE topology MATCH p = (a:Address {address: "0x9740a8e0197689d144b19da4bdc9ef65fef11cda"})-[:LINKED]-{1,2}(b:Address) RETURN b.address AS linked_address, length(p) AS hops LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (owner:Address)-[o:OPERATED_BY]->(operator:Address {address: "0xdd509c9f91f66a18802ef5b3d54c73b62ea1ca08"}) RETURN owner.address AS owner_address, o.tx_count AS tx_count, o.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum ORDER BY o.tx_count DESC LIMIT 10

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "0x0168d9f5cac7d63eb75095cef316d68b0dc42bc6"})-[s:SWAPPED]->(b:Address) RETURN b.address AS recipient, s.sold_usd AS sold_usd, s.bought_usd AS bought_usd, s.pools AS pools ORDER BY s.swap_count DESC LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (b:Address)-[f:FLOWS_TO]->(p:Address {address: "0xd42a491087a15e5afd51feb3606066cc152d2b09"}) WHERE NOT b:Pool RETURN b.address AS from_address, p.address AS to_address, labels(p) AS to_node_labels, f.tx_count AS tx_count, f.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, f.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, f.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp, b.labels AS from_labels, p.labels AS to_labels, b.is_exchange AS from_is_exchange, p.is_exchange AS to_is_exchange ORDER BY f.tx_count DESC LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "0x7a31dd32a880827477ab2bbeff47db188c896815"})-[:FLOWS_TO]->(p:Pool)-[r:REMOVED_LIQUIDITY]->(b:Address) WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System AND NOT a.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"] AND b.address <> a.address RETURN p.address AS pool, b.address AS receiver, sum(r.usd) AS removed_usd, max(r.receiver_added_usd) AS receiver_added_usd, max(r.receiver_provided) AS receiver_provided LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "0x9a8f92a830a5cb89a3816e3d267cb7791c16b04d"})-[x:BRIDGED]->(c:Chain) RETURN c.network AS remote_network, c.address AS endpoint, x.kind AS kind, x.asset AS asset, x.events AS events, x.amount_raw_sum AS amount_raw_sum LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH p = (a:Address {address: "0x04911a118f11c75667e4d0dfb8e640af5a353550"} WHERE NOT a:Pool AND NOT a:Protocol AND NOT a:System) (()-[t:TRANSFERRED WHERE t.asset = "0x5fc5360d0400a0fd4f2af552add042d716f1d168"]->(via:Address) WHERE NOT via:Pool AND NOT via:Protocol AND NOT via:System AND NOT via.address IN ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead"]){0,2} ()-[:TRANSFERRED {asset: "0x5fc5360d0400a0fd4f2af552add042d716f1d168"}]->(b:Address) RETURN b.address AS to_address, length(p) AS hops LIMIT 25

USE topology MATCH (a:Address)-[t:TRANSFERRED]->(b:Address) WHERE t.asset = "0x5fc5360d0400a0fd4f2af552add042d716f1d168" AND t.last_seen_timestamp >= 1792368000000 RETURN b.address AS receiver, sum(t.amount_usd_sum) AS received_usd, count(*) AS links ORDER BY received_usd DESC LIMIT 10
